title: v2: name enrolled speakers automatically after diarization
description: After diarization, compute an embedding per detected speaker and label speakers that match an enrolled person by name (goal 5).
steps: Create `diarization/SpeakerSampleCollector.kt`: `object SpeakerSampleCollector { fun collect(samples: FloatArray, turns: List<SpeakerTurn>, speakerMap: (Int) -> Int?, maxMs: Long = 30_000, minTurnMs: Long = 500): Map<Int, FloatArray> }` — for each final speaker index (via `speakerMap` from raw diarizer speaker to renumbered index), concatenate the samples of its turns (16 samples per ms, clamp to array bounds), skipping turns shorter than `minTurnMs`, up to `maxMs` total; drop speakers with less than 2 000 ms collected.
Change `SpeakerAssigner.Assignment` to also expose `val rawToIndex: Map<Int, Int>` (raw diarizer speaker → renumbered index) and update its tests.

Extend `DiarizeSessionUseCase` with constructor params `embedderFactory: SpeakerEmbedderFactory` and `enrolled: EnrolledSpeakerStore`. After assignment, if `enrolled.getAll()` is not empty: collect samples, embed each speaker (one embedder, `use {}`), `SpeakerMatcher.assignNames(embeddings, enrolled, settings.speakerMatchThreshold)`, and pass the names to the repository. Change `SessionRepository.applyDiarization` to accept `labels: Map<Int, String>` (default empty) used instead of `Speaker N` where present. Embedding failures must not fail diarization: catch, log with `Log.w(TAG, ...)`, and keep default labels.
In `SettingsScreen` Speakers section add a "Voice match threshold" slider 0.3..0.8 bound to `speakerMatchThreshold`.
Update `AppContainer` wiring and extend `DiarizeSessionUseCaseTest` and `SpeakerAssignerTest`; add `SpeakerSampleCollectorTest`.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: with an enrolled "Alice" whose embedding equals the fake embedder's output for speaker 0, speaker 0 is labelled `Alice` and speaker 1 `Speaker 2`
Test: no enrolled speakers → embedder factory never created
Test: embedder throwing → session still DIARIZED with default labels
Test: SpeakerSampleCollector caps at 30 000 ms, skips short turns and drops speakers under 2 000 ms
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
